basic_profile.bio: A 27-year-old from Pittsburgh with a passion for video games and strategy board games. Currently working as a software developer, I spend my free time watching Let's Plays on YouTube, particularly those from Kubz Scouts. I've been a fan of the Danganronpa series for a few years, and I enjoy discussing game theories and character dynamics. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends. A big fan of strategy games and always looking for new gameplay tips.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science and works as a software developer. Gained interest in video games through college friends and self-taught many gaming strategies through online forums and YouTube channels. Actively engages in discussions about game mechanics and storytelling.
